A.validity: the run is valid when the A10 rule of steer_follow_gsim_v1 holds (RTF of the run, emulator /clock wall gap above 100 ms, host latch made by a SIM stall) AND the smallest 5 s /clock window RTF of the check (rtf.min of the record) is >= 0.9; an invalid run is recorded, not judged, and run once more on a fresh stack; a slot invalid twice is reported as not judged
A.passed: every judged run passes every criterion of steer_follow_gsim_v1 (row_end, no pause after the drive started, lateral / heading / speed / e / clearance limits, rest speed, no guard ending, no commanded steering motion in the 3 s after the end) and at least three of the four slots are judged

B.check: the SIM dashboard in Chrome (playwright, the page as an operator uses it); services sim, steer, recorder, dashboard, executor; scene w1_force

items.name: prepare
items.rule: the auto panel offers 준비; pressing it (and Arm if the page offers it) reaches 자율 주행 시작 within 16 s; a second press is recorded

items.name: one_press_running
items.rule: go_ready, one press -> 주행 중 within 10 s and the vehicle moves (emulator speed > 0.05 m/s)

items.name: heartbeat
items.rule: heartbeats while the tab is visible: largest gap of the last 20 < 0.35 s

items.name: tab_hidden_link_lost
items.rule: tab hidden -> run_state paused, stop_reason OPERATOR_LINK_LOST at 1.5 s, no heartbeat after hiding, the vehicle stopped (< 0.05 m/s) 4 s after hiding, visible again -> 다시 출발 and still paused

items.name: screen_stop_while_running
items.rule: a new run, one press, 6 s of driving, the status-bar STOP -> stop_detail operator_stop (stop_reason OPERATOR_OR_BACKSTOP), the vehicle stopped within 3 s, no restart

items.name: live_map
items.rule: the dashboard's own live map started from the page builds from the SIM scans: /api/live/map scan_count > 0 after 20 s

B.validity: the session is valid when the RTF of the check node stays >= 0.9 in the steps (else run once more)

C.check: steering.exec_checks safety --out /runs/safety (scene w0_force, the executor in one_press)
C.criteria: SIM_ACCEPTANCE_KO.md A17 per script as coded in exec_checks (with amendment 31: operator link lost -> drive 0 <= 0.5 s + 1 tick); deadman_release is not applicable to one_press
C.validity: A10 rule per step (exec_checks); invalid steps are run once more with --only
C.passed: every valid step passes; steps invalid twice are reported

D.criteria: A25 as coded in p6a_checks (joint - shared model p99 <= 0.2 deg at the best lag, no joint speed spikes, the steering moved, no drive refusal), with the host bridge of the final image (amendment 43: steering_not_following counts settled ramp lines only)

E.criteria: executor: POST /api/params speed_scale 1.10 accepted at rest, the status shows it with revision +1 and a new digest, the next run starts with that digest, the executor table speed at 50 % duty moves by 1.10 +- 1 %, the default preset restored; plant: the Gazebo plant steady speed ratio at 50 % duty is reported (the Gazebo drive model does not read the tuning file)

host: before each session the host-load check of STACK_OPERATIONS_KO.md section 2 is recorded; the stall probe is not run in these sessions
